# Nebulux

Nebulux is a dark, neon sci-fi theme that its recorded description frames as an interstellar cruiser cockpit dashboard. It uses glassmorphism, neon gradient headers, a dynamic rainbow file explorer and themed callouts for dashboards and data, with Style Settings for deeper customization.

![Nebulux screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sikoso774/Nebulux/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Nebulux"
    author: "sikoso774"
    repo:   "sikoso774/Nebulux"
    slug:   "nebulux"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/nebulux"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/sikoso774/Nebulux"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sikoso774/Nebulux/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Transform Obsidian into an interstellar cruiser dashboard with a dark, neon sci‑fi cockpit UI for focused, immersive note work. Use glassmorphism, neon gradient headers, a dynamic rainbow file explorer, and themed callouts to organize dashboards and data, with Style Settings for deep customization."
}
```
